digest.component_or_area: Advanced CLI parsers, help generation, argparse formatter pinning
propositions: Four rendered advanced CLI factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stock argparse.HelpFormatter instead of version-pinned RebarHelpFormatter, creating a py3.13 help-rendering staleness trap identical to the S2d regression.
Help artifacts rendered by gen_cli_help.py for bridge (RebarHelpFormatter, width-80) and bridge-fsck (stock HelpFormatter, width-78) are inconsistently wrapped within the same command family.

Any py3.13 argparse divergence (short+long metavar rendering, usage wrapping) affecting the four unprotected factories would silently stale their committed help artifacts only on py3.13 CI, mimicking the S2d failure mode.
Contract test validates that all help-backed (rendered) route factories use RebarHelpFormatter or a subclass, preventing regression of the four formatters and future introductions.
